name: werun-coaching
description: Every script in js/ is plain, unbundled JavaScript the browser loads directly — there is no build step and there is not going to be one. The site ships exactly one third-party file to a browser, js/vendor/jsqr-1.4.0.js, vendored from the jsqr devDependency below and fetched only when an athlete opens the check-in scanner; see js/vendor/README.md. Everything else here is for the tools: wrangler, which runs the Worker and the D1 database locally and applies migrations on deploy, and the two libraries the QR test uses to check js/qr.js against a real encoder and a real decoder.
